problem_text: A block of mass (m) 20.0 kg and a density (D) of 19.0 x 10$^3$ kg/m$^3$ is immersed in sea water using a cable and is at rest. The density of sea water (d) is 1.03 x 10$^3$ kg/m$^3$. The acceleration due to gravity (g) at that location is 10.0 m/s$^2$. Calculate the tension (T) in the cable.
